name: Breda
description: Blacksmith NPC. Her dialogue identifies her shop as Iron and Ember and offers weapon and armor buying/selling. She is also officially confirmed to offer a Part-Time Job while sleeping.
source: Official Discord small-updates v1.1.7 + user-supplied in-game screenshots on 2026-08-18

name: Eren
description: Forgemaster NPC at Iron and Ember who handles equipment upgrading, crafting, Spirit Stone infusion, and equipment identification. He is also officially confirmed to offer a Part-Time Job while sleeping.
source: Official Discord small-updates v1.1.7 + user-supplied in-game screenshots on 2026-08-18

name: Neria
description: Librarian NPC who sells Skill Books. Her shop supports General, Warrior, Defender, Cleric, and Enchanter categories. She is also officially confirmed to offer a Part-Time Job while sleeping.
source: Official Discord small-updates v1.1.7 + user-supplied in-game screenshots on 2026-08-18

name: Rendall
description: Bartender and general-goods vendor. His dialogue invites the player to buy or sell goods, and his shop carries tools, seeds, scrolls, food, cooking-related goods, and feed.

name: Theron
description: Village Elder of Dewdrop who acts as an information and lore NPC. His dialogue introduces Dewdrop Village, points the player toward important locals, comments on portal stories, and confirms that he knew the player's family.
dialogueOptions: Where am I? What is this place?
Who should I talk to in the village?
I keep hearing strange stories. Portals, conspiracies...

dialogueFacts.locationIntro: Dewdrop Village is described as the safest corner of a wide world; Theron advises staying to the lit paths until ready for the wild patches.
dialogueFacts.portalRumors: Theron dismisses the village's portal stories as ghost stories and shapes in the dark, though his response suggests familiarity with the rumors.
dialogueFacts.familyConnection: Theron says he knew the player's family well, names Veren as someone who repaired his fence, and says the player's mother bargained like a soldier.
